indexes.name: audit_events_event_sequence_uq
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX audit_events_event_sequence_uq ON public.audit_events USING btree (event_sequence)

indexes.name: audit_events_object_sequence_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX audit_events_object_sequence_idx ON public.audit_events USING btree (object_type, object_id_text, event_sequence)

indexes.name: audit_events_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX audit_events_pkey ON public.audit_events USING btree (id)

indexes.name: idx_audit_actor
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_audit_actor ON public.audit_events USING btree (actor_user_id, ts_utc DESC)

indexes.name: idx_audit_candidate_auth_mutation_receipt_v1
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_audit_candidate_auth_mutation_receipt_v1 ON public.audit_events USING btree (object_type, object_id_text, correlation_id, ts_utc DESC, id DESC) WHERE (object_type = 'candidate_auth_mutation_receipt'::text)

indexes.name: idx_audit_candidate_workflow_mutation_receipt_v1
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_audit_candidate_workflow_mutation_receipt_v1 ON public.audit_events USING btree (object_type, object_id_text, correlation_id, ts_utc DESC, id DESC) WHERE (object_type = 'candidate_workflow_mutation_receipt'::text)

indexes.name: idx_audit_candidate_workflow_mutation_request_v1
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_audit_candidate_workflow_mutation_request_v1 ON public.audit_events USING btree (correlation_id, ts_utc DESC, id DESC) WHERE (object_type = 'candidate_workflow_mutation_receipt'::text)

indexes.name: idx_audit_import_correction_source_v1
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_audit_import_correction_source_v1 ON public.audit_events USING btree (((after_json ->> 'shift_id'::text)), ((after_json ->> 'external_row_key'::text)), ((after_json ->> 'correction_id'::text)), action, ts_utc DESC, id) WHERE ((object_type = ANY (ARRAY['timesheets'::text, 'invoices'::text, 'contract_weeks'::text])) AND (action = ANY (ARRAY['NHSP_IMPORT_CORRECTION_APPLIED'::text, 'HR_IMPORT_CORRECTION_APPLIED'::text])))

indexes.name: idx_audit_lookup
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_audit_lookup ON public.audit_events USING btree (object_type, object_id_text, ts_utc DESC)

indexes.name: idx_weekly_source_later_change_receipt_v1
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_weekly_source_later_change_receipt_v1 ON public.audit_events USING btree (((after_json ->> 'idempotency_key'::text)), ts_utc, id) WHERE (action = 'WEEKLY_SOURCE_LATER_CHANGE_DECIDED'::text)

constraints.name: audit_events_actor_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (actor_user_id) REFERENCES tms_users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
